boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup + scientific-educational. Create a hand-annotated continuous storyboard for the existing desktop Chinese VibePolaris Agent Harness lesson. This is ONE coherent storyboard, not alternative design options. Use the supplied current product screenshot as reference only for warm ivory background, black typography, restrained forest-green controls and small lime star brand. Replace its old feedback-summary content entirely. Target canvas 1536x2048 portrait: two spacious landscape desktop lesson frames stacked vertically, each about 1440x900, readable at full resolution. No phone devices, browser chrome or perspective. Warm ivory flat page, generous whitespace. Crisp printed Chinese for UI, warm human hand-drawn coral-red pencil/marker circles, arrows and very short Chinese margin notes as teaching annotations. Slightly imperfect black ink illustrations; no photorealism, heavy shadow, dense prose, extra dashboards, orbit spaghetti, decorative confetti.
Both frames use exactly the same stable positions: model illustrated as a small friendly star-like abstract character at LEFT labelled 模型; a simple open work area in CENTER labelled Harness containing the current input/message slips; one document with a small read-tool icon at RIGHT labelled 文件工具, filename todo.txt. Small site mark VibePolaris and lime star upper left; modest Agent Harness title, current question largest. Show the Harness as the coordinating area connected to the separate model and file tool; no direct model-to-file arrow. Requests and results are meaningful labelled slips moving between these positions. Only current active path emphasized, inactive paths pale. Bottom small progress fraction and 上一步 / 下一步 green control. Handwritten annotations must point to the exact object they explain and not overlap text. Each frame has one numbered step and a maximum of TWO short doodle notes. Preserve readable Chinese and exact task/file data; no invented words. The teaching data will be: todo.txt contains checked 买咖啡, unchecked 寄快递, unchecked 给绿植浇水. Do NOT reveal these contents until step 4. No dates.
THIS IMAGE IS THE FIRST BOARD: steps 01 and 02 only.
Top frame 01 title "模型知道文件里有什么吗？". Show task sentence "读一下 todo.txt，告诉我还有哪两件事没做。" as a user message arriving at Harness center. Model LEFT waiting, file RIGHT closed, only filename visible. No file body. Handwritten coral note with circle on filename "知道文件名 ≠ 读过内容"; little question mark by model with note "现在还不知道". Progress 1 / 6. Previous disabled, next active.
Bottom frame 02 title "先把任务和工具说明交给模型". Same positions; Harness center has a small stack of precisely TWO input slips: "任务：找出未完成事项" and "工具：read_file(path) · 读取文件". One clear labelled arrow "第一次调用" travels FROM Harness CENTER TO model LEFT. The file at RIGHT remains closed and inactive. Circle the two slips with doodle note "这就是本次输入"; annotation pointing at the closed file "文件内容还没送来". Progress 2 / 6. No tool invocation yet, no completed checkmarks, no tool result. Minimal elegant desktop product storyboard with annotation directly on the design.
boards.correction: Edit the attached two-frame storyboard with TWO precise corrections only. Preserve all typography, layout, colors, character, data, doodles, spacing and every other detail. In the TOP frame 01, REMOVE the dashed black arrow that goes from the star model on the left into the Harness user-message box. Step 01 is before any model response; no active arrow from model is correct. Leave empty whitespace between the model and Harness. In the BOTTOM frame 02 only, make the 上一步 button enabled, using a readable dark green/black label and thin outline, unlike the disabled pale 上一步 in frame 01 which must remain disabled. Do not change the correct leftward 第一次调用 arrow in frame 02.

THIS IS THE SECOND BOARD, continuing the attached first board in precisely the same style, typography, two-frame layout, star character, stable role positions, warm ivory background, green buttons and coral handwritten teaching notes. Draw steps 03 and 04, not alternative concepts.
Top frame 03 title "模型提出一个读取请求". The star model LEFT has just returned a request, a black arrow points LEFT model → CENTER Harness. In Harness center show readable structured request "read_file(path=\"todo.txt\")". Small caption "工具请求". File RIGHT still closed. End the current arrow at the Harness request; NO outgoing execution arrow yet. Coral handwritten note circle request "请求 ≠ 已执行"; second note pointing at file "还没打开". Progress 3 / 6; BOTH previous and next enabled.
Bottom frame 04 title "工具真正打开文件". Same roles. Model LEFT quiet and pale; no incoming data to model. Harness CENTER shows request "read_file(\"todo.txt\")" with small printed "读取已允许". The contents can be partly duplicated on small result slip at Harness but keep typography spacious. Coral doodle note pointing to the right tool "工具在这里读文件"; second note on return arrow "结果先回到 Harness". Progress 4 / 6; both buttons enabled. No second model invocation yet and no final answer. All arrowheads must be correct and unambiguous; request rightward, result leftward, at different heights.
boards.correction: Edit ONLY the black horizontal arrow in the TOP frame 03 of this attached two-frame storyboard. It currently points LEFT toward the star, which is conceptually wrong. Reverse it so it points RIGHT from the star model into the tool-request card inside Harness. The arrowhead MUST be at the RIGHT END near the Harness/card left edge, and the LEFT END near the star must be a plain line with NO arrowhead. This step depicts the model RETURNING a tool request to Harness. Keep the same horizontal line location and length. Do not change ANY text, characters, panel spacing, doodles, colors or buttons. Leave the entire BOTTOM frame 04 completely unchanged, especially its correct rightward execution arrow and leftward result arrow.
